# github_enterprise_budget (Data Source)

Reads one billing budget, including the amount consumed so far. Read-only: it never creates or changes a budget.

## Example

```hcl
data "github_enterprise_budget" "actions" {
  provider = github-enterprise

  budget_id = "BUDGET_ID"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Requirement | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alert_recipients` | `List of String` | Read-only | Logins that receive budget alerts. Always an empty list when alerts are disabled. |
| `alerts_enabled` | `Bool` | Read-only | Whether GitHub sends budget alerts. |
| `budget_amount` | `Number` | Read-only | Budget amount in whole dollars, or a number of licenses for license-based products. |
| `budget_entity_name` | `String` | Read-only | Entity the budget applies to, as GitHub reports it. GitHub answers with the entity's display name, so this may differ from the login configured on the resource. |
| `budget_id` | `String` | Required | Opaque budget ID assigned by GitHub. |
| `budget_product_sku` | `String` | Read-only | Product or SKU covered by the budget, or null. |
| `budget_scope` | `String` | Read-only | Scope the budget applies to. |
| `budget_type` | `String` | Read-only | Pricing model: `ProductPricing`, `SkuPricing` or `BundlePricing`. |
| `consumed_amount` | `Number` | Read-only | Amount consumed so far, in the budget's unit. |
| `enterprise_slug` | `String` | Optional | Enterprise account slug. Defaults to the provider-level enterprise_slug. |
| `expires_at` | `String` | Read-only | Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null. |
| `id` | `String` | Read-only | enterprise_slug:budget_id. |
| `prevent_further_usage` | `Bool` | Read-only | Whether GitHub blocks additional spending once the budget is exceeded. |
| `user` | `String` | Read-only | Login the budget applies to, or null for other scopes. |

See the [provider guide](https://github.com/vmvarela/terraform-provider-github-enterprise#authentication) for authentication, ownership and compatibility requirements.
